msg: Why should I buy an EV instead of a petrol bike?
reply: EVs give you huge savings on fuel—about ₹26 per 100 km versus ₹258 for a petrol bike—plus instant torque, zero emissions and far fewer moving parts to service. Ready to hear how the T30 fits your ride needs?

msg: What are the specs of the T30?
reply: The T30 hits 0‑60 km/h in about 3.5 seconds, tops out at 135 km/h, and offers roughly a 200 km range. It’s got a 17.7 cm touchscreen, fast‑charge 20‑80 % in 36 minutes, and starts at ₹239 k. Want details on a specific colour or to book a test ride?

msg: What makes Raptee different from other EV bikes?
reply: Raptee’s T30 plugs into the CCS‑2 universal fast‑charging network used by electric cars, so you can charge at any car charger and get a 20‑80 % top‑up in about 36 minutes. It also comes with built‑in telematics, OTA updates and a “Find My Raptee” tracker. Want to hear how that compares to the T30 Sport?

msg: What warranty and support do you offer?
reply: We give an 8‑year (or 80,000 km) battery warranty, a 3‑year (or 30,000 km) vehicle warranty, plus one year of doorstep service and roadside assistance. Comprehensive insurance options are also available at purchase. Want me to note any of that for you?

msg: What's the difference between the T30 and T30 Sport?
reply: Both the T30 and T30 Sport have the same performance—0‑60 in 3.5 seconds, 135 km/h top speed, about 200 km range and identical charging times—and they cost the same. The Sport version is simply a sport‑tuned trim with different styling, so you’d pick it if you prefer the look and feel. Want to see which colors we have in your city?

msg: How much would I save riding 150km a day compared to a petrol bike?
reply: Riding the T30 for 150 km a day would cost about ₹38 in electricity versus roughly ₹386 for petrol – you’d save around ₹348 a day, about a 90 % reduction. Want to see how that translates into a monthly budget?
